leads.claim: Apollo 17 crew reported seeing jagged, angular particles or fragments drifting near the spacecraft.
leads.why: The description refers to conventional space debris or ice particles associated with spacecraft transit, not UAP material.

leads.claim: Recovery team for the Mercury-Redstone 4 mission discussed a dye pack that failed to activate during recovery.
leads.why: This is a standard description of a conventional equipment failure during a known NASA mission recovery operation.

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence or suggestions of obtained UAP material; it consists entirely of records regarding conventional sightings, administrative correspondence, and standard space mission recovery operations.
